sloka: अथवा वर्तते तत्र वसन्तो यत्र मे प्रिया  ।किम् करिष्यति सुश्रोणी सा तु निर् भर्त्सिता परैः ॥४-१-४९॥
transliteration: athavā vartate tatra vasanto yatra me priyā  ।kim kariṣyati suśroṇī sā tu nir bhartsitā paraiḥ ॥4-1-49॥

translations.english: 'Eager to speak with her gentle voice, my young beloved, blessed with eyes like lotus petals, will certainly give up her life, unable to enjoy the spring.
